sources.title: Ecommerce UX Audit: How to Find What's Hurting Your Conversion
sources.takeaway: Checkout and shipping/tax surprises are leading abandonment drivers; audit against heuristics.

sources.title: Ecommerce UX That Converts: 2026 Guide
sources.takeaway: Reviews near add-to-cart, guest checkout, free-shipping progress.

sources.title: GEO for ecommerce: How to get your products cited by AI search engines
sources.takeaway: Complete Product schema, crawlable pages, answer-first copy.

sources.title: AEO/GEO playbook for Shopify brands
sources.takeaway: Brand-owned FAQs, policies, sizing guides are what AI cites.

sources.title: Generative Engine Optimization for Shopify
sources.takeaway: Allow AI crawlers (OAI-SearchBot etc.); claims unverified by OpenAI docs.

sources.title: Agentic Commerce: An Executive Guide (2026)
sources.takeaway: Platform view of agentic commerce; UCP co-developed with Google; clean product data is the bottleneck.

sources.title: Shopify shipped native llms.txt, agents.md, UCP discovery and agentic sitemap to every store
sources.takeaway: Explains the agents.md + /.well-known/ucp + MCP discovery chain now live on all Shopify stores; agents.md is a manual, not a feed.

sources.title: Ecommerce GEO in 2026 (Optimize for AI-Powered Search)
sources.takeaway: Attribute-rich structured product data beats marketing copy for AI citation.

sources.title: AEO for Product Pages
sources.takeaway: Answer-first openings weighted heavily; spec tables let engines answer attribute questions. Cited stat (44.2% of LLM citations from first 30% of content) unverified.

sources.title: Product Page Conversion Rate Statistics
sources.takeaway: Add-to-cart rate (Littledata Shopify median 6.8%) is a better PDP metric than purchase CVR. Figures directional.

sources.title: AI Shopping Assistant Guide 2026: Agentic Commerce Protocols
sources.takeaway: ACP vs UCP landscape; price/stock/policy consistency across surfaces is the main failure mode.

sources.title: Product Launch Marketing Playbook for DTC (2026)
sources.takeaway: 6-8 week pre-launch runway; waitlist->presale conversion target 8-15%; 24-72h exclusive window for list. Vendor benchmarks, unvalidated.
